label: What is maximal in a GENUS_2 is the cause of that perfection in every other thing that has it
paraphrase: What is maximal in a genus (a perfection) is the cause of that perfection in every other thing that has it.
note: This remains an unattributed OPEN analyst principle for every merely maximal bearer, including otherwise admissible incomparable maxima. The greatest-degree source claim is separate and supplies no inference to this stronger conditional.
